BiblicalUsage: A couch is a bed, and Isaiah uses the word once, in the warning that the bed is shorter than a man can stretch himself on: the covering is too narrow to wrap in, and the resting place is no rest at all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is of a people trying to rest on their own arrangements, and finding the bed too short: only God's provision fits, and everything else leaves you uncovered.
